decision: Runtime bootstrap boundaries recovered from frozen native framework; separate dependency policy for main and sandbox preload. Full native provider remains unqualified.
analysisMethod: REA original application results supplemented under plan4.6 by complete AST parsing of newly selected embedded source; no new REA run.

source.selectionRule: Within __TEXT,__cstring select NUL strings longer than 2048 bytes with a leading license source label, or both process._linkedBinding( and ./lib/; this is a bounded selection, not a proof that all embedded JavaScript was found.

facts.claim: 冻结框架的 __TEXT,__cstring 选定规则提取7份可完整解析的JavaScript，共427893字节。该规则不证明所有嵌入JS均已找到。
7份源码含213个有路径标签的模块工厂出现位置、150个不同标签；167个位置以./lib/开头，46个位置带node_modules路径。出现位置、路径标签及原始源文件不是同一分母。
browserModuleList包含39个API loader；exports/electron通过defineProperties创建惰性getter并按__esModule/default拆包。app、BrowserWindow、Notification、Session等选定API随后装配到process._linkedBinding返回的对象或构造器。
7份源码中有59处未被同名process声明遮蔽的process._linkedBinding调用，涉及44个字面绑定名；另有别名接收者。全部._linkedBinding成员调用共102处/49个字面名称，后者是语法清单，不能未经provider链检查全部计为同一全局process调用。
screen导出Proxy，首次属性访问时调用原生createScreen，函数属性bind到该实例；systemPreferences直接导出绑定对象并增加少量getter。它们的目标平台效果没有在这些wrapper内恢复。
选定renderer contextBridge包装先检查contextIsolated，否则抛错；exposeInMainWorld调用绑定的exposeAPIInWorld(0,...)，executeInMainWorld调用executeInWorld(0,...)。这不证明任意runtime都提供这些原生方法。
sandbox pre-init把process/browser模块对象的_linkedBinding赋为外部binding.get，合并binding.process并接入EventEmitter原型；源码位置位于运行时装配层，包名相同不能充抵该装配。
sandbox入口建立5个已加载模块名与4个惰性模块名；preloadRequire先查缓存再查loader，未知名称抛错。preload process通常不主动增加_linkedBinding，仅测试switch分支赋入该属性；后续合并外部process对象的内容仍属外部输入，不能宣称最终对象绝对不含该属性。

BROWSER_SANDBOX_LOAD主侧按frame/service-worker选择preload，过滤非绝对路径，读取UTF-8内容并逐条返回contents/error；返回webPreferences及process元数据字段。handleSync以[null,await result]或[error]回复，renderer invokeSync解包并在error truthy时抛出。记录源码字段，不读取实际环境变量。

sandbox逐条执行preload：contents truthy时包装require/process/exports/module和exposeGlobals；error truthy时报告BROWSER_PRELOAD_ERROR；空内容无error时跳过。getIPCRenderer按renderer/service-worker分别创建并缓存，其他类型抛错。这是进程类型分支，不能作为Codex/ChatGPT模式判定。
选定frame IPC invoke按frame.ipc、sender.ipc、全局ipcMain顺序选择第一个拥有handler的emitter；internal和service-worker有各自分流。此wrapper选择规则不证明RAM-13要求的底层网络或越界IPC enforcement。
46个node_modules模块标签给出23个包名线索和31个包安装位置标签。嵌套位置分别保留；未据此推断实际版本、许可、未修改状态或跨位置同版本。
源码装配支持按进程制定构建规则：sandbox preload所需JS可以由锁定依赖在构建时打包，维护源码仍以包导入；不应把所有第三方依赖一律external。需要未列入loader的Node/native能力时，必须另行落实main/受控桥接口及其原有行为。
恢复上述wrapper边界未取得原生C++实现、独立Owl SDK/headers或完整构建配方，也未验证ABI、clone、权限、特权设置或实际产品行为；现有完整运行时采用数维持0。

nonstandardNameObservations.qualification: String presence is not registration, callable method presence, native implementation or semantic proof; no matching atom for setLegacyChromePolicyFallbackEnabled does not prove absence of its implementation.

preloadBuildDecisions.decision: Keep runtime bootstrap and embedded upstream implementations outside restored first-party business source. Runtime dependency must have independent provenance/version/ABI/build policy.

Use process-specific externalization. Bundle required sandbox-preload JS from package dependencies; retain source-level package imports and exact new lock. A package installed on disk is not automatically visible to preloadRequire.
Register preload resources using independent packaged absolute paths; preserve per-entry read/execute failures and process-type handling. Do not depend on the original application path.
Keep privileged Node/native operations behind explicitly restored main/bridge contracts where required. Do not expose _linkedBinding merely to bypass sandbox packaging.

remaining.runtimeSourceAndBuild: Native C++ implementation, independently sourced provider/headers/toolchain, ABI and complete runtime behavior still require evidence. No provider adopted.
remaining.dependencyIdentity: 23 runtime-embedded name hints require actual release/version/license/modification evidence. Do not add23 to202 as a count of distinct installed dependencies.
remaining.selectionCoverage: The cstring predicate is bounded; scripts with other encodings, compression, naming or no factory labels may be missed.
remaining.productModeAndBehavior: No new mode classification, launch, model submission, UI observation, persistence or restart acceptance.
